info.description: Run in order. 43 cases covering active filters, OR selections, nested models, specifications, empty results, validation and reset. Each valid request also verifies count/list totals. Requires advanced facets deployed (aa7d239 or later). Empty spec groups are valid if source specs are missing. Reset comparison assumes stable database. Counts across calls can differ if inventory changes during the run. Run with 500ms delay to reduce rate limiting. No request bodies or auth required. This collection is generated and syntax-checked; not executed in Postman here.
